ns2:course.label: Computer Engineering I
ns2:course.description: Digital logic and computer systems. Representation of information; combinational network analysis and design; sequential network analysis and design; computer organization and control. Laboratory for design and simulation of digital systems. Credit is not given for both ECE 290 and CS 231. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in ECE 190.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both ECE 290 and CS 231. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in ECE 190.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
